core_query: phenylketonuria OR phenylketonurias OR hyperphenylalaninemia OR "phenylalanine hydroxylase deficiency"

subqueries.dietary_management: phenylketonuria AND (diet OR dietary OR "phenylalanine intake" OR "medical food" OR "protein substitute")
subqueries.bh4_sapropterin: phenylketonuria AND (sapropterin OR tetrahydrobiopterin OR Kuvan OR BH4)
subqueries.pegvaliase: phenylketonuria AND (pegvaliase OR Palynziq OR "phenylalanine ammonia lyase")
subqueries.lnaa: phenylketonuria AND ("large neutral amino acids" OR LNAA)
subqueries.neurocognitive: phenylketonuria AND (cognitive OR neuropsychological OR "executive function" OR IQ OR "white matter")
subqueries.monitoring: phenylketonuria AND ("blood phenylalanine" OR "dried blood spot" OR monitoring)
subqueries.gene_enzyme_therapy: phenylketonuria AND ("gene therapy" OR mRNA OR AAV OR "enzyme substitution")
subqueries.guidelines: phenylketonuria AND (guideline OR consensus OR recommendation OR "standard of care")

bh4_deficiencies.query: "tetrahydrobiopterin deficiency" OR "tetrahydrobiopterin deficiencies" OR "BH4 deficiency" OR "BH4 deficiencies" OR "biopterin metabolism" OR "GTP cyclohydrolase I deficiency" OR "GTP cyclohydrolase deficiency" OR "6-pyruvoyl-tetrahydropterin synthase" OR "6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase" OR "PTPS deficiency" OR "dihydropteridine reductase" OR "sepiapterin reductase deficiency" OR "pterin-4a-carbinolamine dehydratase" OR primapterinuria OR DNAJC12

monoamine_synthesis_disorders.query: "aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency" OR "AADC deficiency" OR "tyrosine hydroxylase deficiency" OR "dopamine beta-hydroxylase deficiency" OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorder" OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorders" OR "pediatric neurotransmitter diseases" OR "primary neurotransmitter disorders" OR "inherited neurotransmitter disorders"

precursor_therapy.query: ("5-hydroxytryptophan" OR oxitriptan OR levodopa OR "L-dopa" OR carbidopa OR sapropterin OR sepiapterin) AND ("tetrahydrobiopterin deficiency" OR "BH4 deficiency" OR "dopa-responsive dystonia" OR "AADC deficiency" OR "tyrosine hydroxylase deficiency" OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorder" OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorders" OR "dihydropteridine reductase" OR "6-pyruvoyl-tetrahydropterin synthase" OR "sepiapterin reductase")

five_htp_clinical.query: ("5-hydroxytryptophan" OR oxitriptan) AND (depression OR depressive OR anxiety OR insomnia OR sleep OR randomized OR randomised OR placebo OR "clinical trial")

monoamine_biomarkers.query: ("homovanillic acid" OR "5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid" OR prolactin OR neopterin OR "urinary pterins" OR "CSF neurotransmitter") AND (tetrahydrobiopterin OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorder" OR "monoamine neurotransmitter disorders" OR "dopa-responsive dystonia" OR "AADC deficiency" OR "monoamine deficiency")

gch1_vascular_pain_reviews.query: (GCH1 OR "GTP cyclohydrolase") AND ("blood pressure" OR endothelial OR "nitric oxide" OR pain OR hypertension) AND review[pt]
